WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
filtered_web_sales AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
),
filtered_catalog_sales AS (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, COUNT(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, COUNT(*) cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM filtered_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM filtered_web_sales WHERE ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM filtered_catalog_sales WHERE cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk)
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
